name: paykernel
description: PayKernel — type-safe payment orchestration toolkit for TypeScript. MENA gateways (Moyasar, PayPal, Paymob, Stripe, Tap, MyFatoorah), portable webhook inbox, reconciliation & multi-store adapters.

scripts.build:types: bun run --filter @paykernel/core build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/webhooks build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/reconciliation build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/opentelemetry build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/routing build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/integration-http build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/integration-hono build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/integration-elysia build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/integration-express build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/integration-cloudflare-workers build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/gateway-tap build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/gateway-myfatoorah build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-contracts build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/testkit build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/sql-foundation build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/internal-sql-store build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-postgres build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-redis build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-sqlite build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-turso build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-d1 build:types && bun run --filter @paykernel/store-durable-objects build:types
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/store-contracts packages/testkit packages/webhooks packages/reconciliation packages/observability packages/routing packages/gateway-tap packages/gateway-myfatoorah packages/sql-foundation internal/sql-store packages/store-postgres packages/store-redis packages/store-sqlite packages/store-turso packages/store-d1 packages/store-durable-objects scripts/check-adapter-selection-honesty.test.ts scripts/check-compat.test.ts scripts/gateway-regressions.test.ts packages/integration-http packages/integration-hono packages/integration-elysia packages/integration-express packages/integration-cloudflare-workers examples

scripts.typecheck:all: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:types
scripts.baseline: bun run baseline:api && bun run baseline:schema && bun run baseline:package
scripts.docs:deploy: bun run docs:build && bun --cwd apps/docs x wrangler deploy
scripts.test:runtime: bun test scripts/check-runtime-portability.test.ts && bun run check:runtime-portability
